title: L'Oréal to invest nearly EUR 300 million to boost French operations by 2029
summary: L'Oréal plans to invest nearly EUR 300 million in France between 2027 and 2029, the French cosmetics giant announced on Friday, November 20. Environment and R&D The investments are intended to "support the environmental transition" of the group's sites, "strengthen its research and innovation capabilities," and "support the development of its activities," the owner of brands such as Garnier, Maybelline, and Lancôme said in a press release. title: Boots taps into 'K-Wellness' with a new line of beauty-from-within products
summary: The UK health and beauty retailer is expanding its wellness offering with a new range of products inspired by the growing ‘K-Wellness' trend.
